_comment: Two frames each: one from just inside the entrance, which is the
frame that has to make four arenas four rooms, and one from the place
the shell exists for -- the rim, an aisle, the deck, a gap.
CAMERA FRAME (L-52): the runner yaws the MODEL 180 degrees and leaves
the camera in world space, so every `eye` here is the manifest anchor
with x and z negated. An eye copied straight out of the manifest
stands outside the room looking in through its own door.

shots.note: 1.00 M ACROSS 12 M IS A SHALLOW READ HEAD-ON. SEE A_PIT_RIM
